title: Bitcoin outpaces gold even as both assets tumble ahead of a likely Fed rate hike
content: Bitcoin held near $64,000 as gold fell 2%, lifting the ratio between the two above its 200-day moving average and extending a series of higher lows since March.

title: Strategy stock could plunge 76% to $23, chart analyst warns
content: Aksel Kibar, who has tracked Bitcoin’s price action since at least 2018, made the bearish call, citing a still-active head-and-shoulders pattern on MicroStrategy’s (MSTR) daily chart.

title: Hyundai tests AI agent commerce on JPMorgan’s Kinexys blockchain
content: The exploration of AI agents with JPMorgan builds on Hyundai’s recent stablecoin-based cross-border remittance pilot.

title: Google finds self-running AI hacking tool with Russian comments in its files
content: Google spots an AI that can find and exploit software flaws on its own, no human needed.

title: Live updates: Bitcoin stuck near $65,000 as popular 'basis trade' returns dry up
content: XRP edged toward $1 and SOL rose 3%, while a Talos report showed crypto’s favorite carry trade now pays about what Treasuries do.

title: Bitwise seeks Texas Stock Exchange listing for Zcash ETF
content: Coinbase Custody would safeguard the fund’s ZEC holdings, while Bitwise Investment Advisers would serve as its manager and sponsor.

title: Bitcoin steadies after Nvidia’s earnings beat as $60K bids stand out
content: Bitcoin halted downside as Nvidia confidence returned, with its stock gaining 3% premarket and South Korea’s tech-heavy KOSPI reclaiming 5,000 points.

title: World Bank partners with Circle, Citi to explore stablecoins for payments
content: The initiative builds on the World Bank’s existing blockchain platform, which aims to create more fund traceability for investments in developing countries.

title: SOL comes out of Breakpoint 7% higher as Solana exits beta
content: Solana’s token reached $75.12 on Tuesday, outpacing Bitcoin and Ether after the network retired the beta label it had used since its 2020 launch.

title: Bitcoin ETFs lose $240M as CryptoQuant flags bearish market phase
content: Bitcoin ETF outflows returned after a one-day pause as CryptoQuant warned that Bitcoin had returned to a bearish market phase.

title: Scattered Spider Hacker Sentenced to 6 Years Over $11.6M in Stolen Crypto
content: Scotland's Tyler Buchanan is the last of five defendants sentenced in a phishing and SIM-swapping scheme that targeted crypto holders.

title: Why Microsoft Thinks Smaller, Cheaper AI Can Beat Claude and GPT
content: Microsoft's new coding, cybersecurity and image models challenge bigger rivals on performance and price. The company's bet is that doing one job exceptionally well matters more than doing absolutely everything.

title: Nvidia Board Shuts Down Jensen Huang Comeback, Launches Search for New CEO
content: Nvidia's board rejected a comeback for its ousted co-founder as it hired a search firm, backed interim CEO Colette Kress, and tightened oversight of chip exports to China.

title: Nvidia Shares Rise After Earnings Beat in First Report Since Jensen Huang's Exit
content: The chipmaker doubled quarterly revenue, forecast another record and rallied after hours, but its first report without Jensen Huang leaves leadership questions and a deeply bruised stock chart unresolved.

title: OpenAI's GPT 6.2 Astra Challenges Anthropic on Price, But Not Every Benchmark
content: OpenAI's latest models promise better professional work for less money, as the company battles Anthropic and Google for AI supremacy and faces tougher questions about increasingly capable systems and safety.
